transfer_rule: FAILED ATTEMPT → RETURN WITH DIFFERENCE; continuation is earned by new evidence, a changed assumption, or a narrowed unknown. DUPLICATE_NO_NEW_INFO cannot manufacture NEXT.
delta: lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs exports explicit FAILURE_RETURN_CLASSES and classifyFailureReturn(packet)
accepted classes are NEW_EVIDENCE, CHANGED_ASSUMPTION, NARROWED_UNKNOWN, DUPLICATE_NO_NEW_INFO
the first three are material RESIDUE rather than blank reset
duplicate-no-new-info suppresses NEXT unless independent material residue/delta creates a contradiction that must be preserved for review
no generic failure prose is interpreted automatically; producers must explicitly classify the return
egress results expose the explicit failure_return class without granting NOW or mutation authority

authority.next: explicit packet continuation subject to reducer precedence

verification.public_ci: .github/workflows/public-surface-check.yml executes that selftest under Validate JIT FIELD handoff compiler

falsifier: Fail if duplicate-no-new-info can create NEXT without independent residue, failure_return can create NOW, generic failure prose is inferred into a class, or material contradiction is discarded.
retirement_when: A broader typed RETURN contract supersedes these exact semantics with equivalent tests and preserves the four-way distinction or a proven smaller equivalent.
